The '''Golden Helmet''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained from opening [[Golden Coconut]]s (5% chance).<ref name="goldhelmetchance" /> This hat can be obtained only once per save file, or once per player in [[Multiplayer]].

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
